question: What is the meaning of dimensions in relation to general details?
description: Dimensions refer to the size, shape, and other measurable aspects of an object or product. In the context of sustainable construction, dimensions are crucial for ensuring that materials and products fit together correctly and can be reused or recycled effectively. They also help in assessing the potential for disassembly and reusability. Dimensions are a key component of the material passport, which outlines the key components of materials and their interrelationships.
